We need to determine criminal charges. Facts: Bus driver hits a child, causing death. This is traffic accident causing death due to negligence? He drove without observing, causing death. Likely crime: Traffic accident causing death (交通肇事罪). In Chinese criminal law, causing death by dangerous driving is 交通肇事罪. Also possibly reckless driving? The driver was employed, but no intent to kill. So not homicide, but traffic accident. Also maybe dangerous driving (dangerous driving causing serious traffic accident). The law: 《刑法》第一百三十三条 交通肇事罪. So charge: 交通肇事罪.

Any other charges? He didn't have other fraud etc. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]交通肇事<eoa>

But need to follow rule: output only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. Actually rule: "When listing the crime name(s) between the [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”." So we should output "交通肇事". Not "交通肇事罪". So final answer: [罪名]交通肇事<eoa>
